title: Matthew: A 28-Day Devotional
description: One chapter of Matthew each day, ordered Matthew 1–28, with a short theme and reflection questions.

days.title: How to boost your reputation
days.summary: Joseph risked his reputation to obey God, and his obedience left a lasting legacy.
reflectionQuestions: Are you choosing between the world's opinion and God's plan?
Who could you pray for in that situation?

days.title: Can you hear God's voice?
days.summary: God speaks clearly through His Son and His Word, revealing His love and forgiveness.
reflectionQuestions: How has God spoken to you in the past?
What is He telling you now?

days.title: Why baptism is our first next step
days.summary: Jesus was baptized in obedience to the Father; baptism is a public first step of faith.
reflectionQuestions: If you haven't been baptized since trusting Christ, what's holding you back?
What is your next step?

days.title: Three steps to overcoming temptation
days.summary: Jesus' wilderness temptation shows how to resist: stay alert, use Scripture, and rely on God's provision.
reflectionQuestions: What tempts you most?
How can God's promises help you resist?

days.title: What it means to be the light of the world
days.summary: Followers of Jesus reflect His light by living and speaking as He did, making their faith visible.
reflectionQuestions: What circumstance requires you to trust God right now?
How can you share your faith in it?

days.title: How to get rid of worry
days.summary: Worry grows from doubting God's provision; the cure starts with a relationship with Jesus and trust in His promises.
reflectionQuestions: What do you worry about most?
Do you fully trust God to provide?

days.title: How to know you know the real Jesus
days.summary: Jesus doesn't save only "good people"; genuine faith shows itself through good fruit.
reflectionQuestions: Have you made a wrong assumption about someone that proved untrue?
What good fruit is God producing in your life?

days.title: Are you living in faith or fear?
days.summary: Real faith in God's promises drives action and pushes out fear.
reflectionQuestions: Does your faith move you to act each day?
Where are you doubting God's promises?
What role does God want you to play?

days.title: Being right with God is not the same as being perfect
days.summary: Jesus came for sinners; salvation is new life received by grace, not earned by rule-keeping.
reflectionQuestions: Is your relationship with Jesus clear?
Are you still trying to earn God's acceptance?
What can you let God fix?

days.title: Three instructions we can all benefit from following
days.summary: Jesus' instructions to His disciples teach living simply and generously, being wise, and not being afraid.
reflectionQuestions: How can you be generous with what you have?
Where do you need more wisdom?
What changes would help you live more simply?

days.title: Are you carrying too much?
days.summary: Our sin and sorrow are too heavy to carry alone; Jesus invites us to give Him the load and find rest.
reflectionQuestions: Have you given control of your life to Jesus?
What load do you need His help with today?

days.title: If you're feeling disliked, you're in good company
days.summary: Opposed by the Pharisees, Jesus heals a man's withered hand, valuing people over rigid rules.
reflectionQuestions: What needs restoring in your life?
Are you following rules rather than Jesus' example?
What can you learn about faith under opposition?

days.title: Don't let obstacles get in your way
days.summary: Jesus met people where they were with parables; we can share the gospel the same way.
reflectionQuestions: What obstacles keep you from sharing the gospel?
How can you overcome them?
Could you share your story?

days.title: Are you in need of a little R&R?
days.summary: Jesus balanced serving crowds with withdrawing to pray; rest and loving others go together.
reflectionQuestions: How can you rearrange your day to spend time with God?
How can you serve people who need your time?

days.title: You don't have to follow rules to follow Jesus
days.summary: Jesus invites us to follow Him, not meet a list of requirements; only His power changes the heart.
reflectionQuestions: What in your heart should you ask Jesus to change?
Have you asked Jesus into your life?

days.title: Who are you putting first in your life?
days.summary: Following Jesus means denying self and submitting fully to Him.
reflectionQuestions: Are you willing to give everything to follow Jesus?
Are you all in or holding onto your rights?
Who can you share Jesus with today?

days.title: Your faith makes a difference
days.summary: A father's persistent faith and the mustard-seed teaching show that God's Word strengthens faith and brings change.
reflectionQuestions: What does your Bible reading look like?
Do your actions reflect what you believe about God's Word?
Have you seen a miracle?

days.title: Experience is a teacher, but not always the best teacher
days.summary: Learning through hurt is costly; Jesus calls us to set boundaries that keep us from sin.
reflectionQuestions: Which parts of your life put you most at risk of sin?
What must you change today?

days.title: Do you know who you're talking to?
days.summary: The rich young ruler saw Jesus as only a good teacher and walked away, missing that he was talking with God.
reflectionQuestions: Is your appreciation of Jesus growing or shrinking?
What would you do differently if Jesus showed up at your door?
What step of faith can you take?

days.title: You don't have to earn God's love
days.summary: The workers paid the same wage show that God's grace comes through relationship, not performance.
reflectionQuestions: How has God been generous to you?
How can you show that generosity to others?
Is God calling you to give more?

days.title: How to be righteous
days.summary: Jesus gives an example to follow, not just directions, and Scripture guides us toward righteousness.
reflectionQuestions: Where are you trying to control an outcome?
Have you brought it to God in Scripture and prayer?

days.title: What if we all discovered a new four-letter word?
days.summary: Jesus answered hostility with love; the greatest commands are to love God and love your neighbor.
reflectionQuestions: How are you experiencing Jesus' love?
How can you draw closer to Him?
What is one way to serve someone today?

days.title: Does what you say match what you do?
days.summary: Jesus warns against hypocrisy; faith that's only rules, not relationship, misleads others.
reflectionQuestions: Do your actions reflect Jesus' love?
Are you letting Him change your heart, not just your behavior?

days.title: The best place to find the truth
days.summary: No one knows the day of Christ's return, so rely on Jesus, Scripture, prayer and obedience, not predictions.
reflectionQuestions: Where do you turn when the Bible is hard to understand?
Who can you ask?
What is your next step?

days.title: Are you playing it safe?
days.summary: The parable of the talents calls for faithful action, not burying what God has given.
reflectionQuestions: Where are you living in "safe mode"?
What is holding you back?
How can you invest what God has given you?

days.title: How to be on the upside of every exchange
days.summary: The woman who anoints Jesus and Judas' betrayal show the daily choice to worship or betray Him.
reflectionQuestions: What are you tempted to trade for the full life Jesus offers?
Do you get more or less than you give when following Him?

days.title: Why the crucifixion?
days.summary: Sin's wage is death; Jesus' willing sacrifice paid the debt and restored us to God.
reflectionQuestions: What sin should you ask God to reveal, and how will you turn from it?
Have you asked Jesus into your life?

days.title: Go ahead and tell everybody
days.summary: Like sharing good news with friends, we share the gospel, knowing Jesus is with us as we make disciples.
reflectionQuestions: Who needs to hear about Jesus?
What keeps you from sharing?
What has Jesus done for you that you could share today?
